Loads the seven food webs analyzed in the manuscript and computes their
empirical metrics. Beagle Channel, Weddell Sea and the two Scotia Sea food
webs are the standardized versions (see `R/compare_networks_refined.R`); their
site identifiers keep the `Std` prefix used in all the result files.

Writes `Data/network_info.rds`, which `HalpernHumanImpact.Rmd` and
`Stabilitysimulations.Rmd` complete with the human impact index and the
self-damping value.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(multiweb)
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
```

```{r loadNetworks, eval = FALSE}
# eval = FALSE: overwrites Data/network_info.rds; run by hand, then re-run
# HalpernHumanImpact.Rmd and Stabilitysimulations.Rmd.

# Depth is the approximate maximum depth of the area; temperature is the mean
# temperature from the literature.
network_info <- tibble::tribble(
  ~site,                ~name,              ~file,                                          ~latitude, ~area_km2, ~depth_m, ~temp_C,
  "GulfSanJorge",       "San Jorge Gulf",   "Data/GulfSanJorge_links_original_2024_06_24_Time_04_30_55.xlsx", 46.0,   34000,  100, 10.55,
  "Std NorthernScotia", "North Scotia Sea", "Data/NorthernScotia_links_standardized.csv",       51.5, 1500000, 3000,  4.00,
  "BurdwoodBank",       "Burdwood Bank",    "Data/BurdwoodBank_links_original_2024_06_24_Time_04_30_53.xlsx", 54.5,   32000,  200,  6.00,
  "Std BeagleChannel",  "Beagle Channel",   "Data/BeagleChannel_links_standarized.csv",         54.5,    1200,  140,  6.80,
  "Std SouthernScotia", "South Scotia Sea", "Data/SouthernScotia_links_standardized.csv",       58.5, 1500000, 3000,  0.50,
  "PotterCove",         "Potter Cove",      "Data/PotterCove_links_original_2024_06_24_Time_04_31_10.xlsx",   62.2,       9,  100, -0.15,
  "Std Weddell Sea",    "Weddell Sea",      "Data/WeddellSea_links_standarized.csv",            76.0,  200400,  500, -0.90
)

load_networks <- function(file) {
  df <- if (grepl("\\.csv$", file)) read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else readxl::read_excel(file)
  graph_from_data_frame(df, directed = TRUE)
}

network_info$igraph <- lapply(network_info$file, load_networks)

network_info <- network_info %>%
  mutate(
    metrics = purrr::map(igraph, function(g) {
      svd_res <- calc_svd_entropy(g)
      mod <- run_infomap(g)
      topo <- multiweb::calc_topological_indices(g)
      qss <- calc_QSS(g, ncores = 8)
      tibble::tibble(
        C = topo$Connectance,
        S = topo$Size,
        LD = topo$LD,
        TLmean = topo$TLmean,
        Vulnerability = topo$Vulnerability,
        Generality = topo$Generality,
        Entropy = svd_res$Entropy,
        Rank = svd_res$Rank,
        Modularity = modularity(mod),
        Groups = length(mod),
        QSS = qss$QSS,
        MaxEigen = qss$MEing
      )
    })
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(metrics) %>%
  mutate(relRank = Rank / S,
         RankDeficiency = 1 - relRank,
         SVDComplexity = 1 - Entropy)

saveRDS(network_info, "Data/network_info.rds")
```

```{r metricsTable}
network_info <- readRDS("Data/network_info.rds")
knitr::kable(network_info %>% dplyr::select(site, S, C, LD, TLmean, SVDComplexity, RankDeficiency, Modularity),
             caption = "Empirical metrics of the seven food webs", digits = 3)
```
